Hey there! Thanks for reaching out to Leafy! 🌿

Since you're about 1,500 miles from our nearest greenhouse, that puts you in **Zone 3** (over 1,000 miles). Here's what to expect:

**Standard Shipping:** 5–8 business days
- Cost: $7.95 (or free on orders of $75+)

**Express Shipping:** Unfortunately, Express isn't available for Zone 3 addresses, so Standard is your option.

One thing to keep in mind: **live plants ship Monday–Wednesday only**, so if you order after noon on a Wednesday, your plants will ship the following Monday.

If you have any other questions before you order, I'm here to help! 🌱
